question: An administrator wants the same approval and task-creation sequence to be callable from several ServiceNow flows. Which Flow Designer component should contain that reusable logic?
options: A subflow with defined inputs and outputs
A scheduled report with shared visibility
A data policy that makes fields mandatory
An email notification triggered by every update
explanation: A subflow encapsulates a reusable automation sequence with defined inputs and outputs so multiple flows can invoke the same governed logic without duplicating it.
subject: ServiceNow Administration Skills
objective: SNADM-053-R1: Select a reusable Flow Designer component for shared automation logic

provenance.answerEvidence: ServiceNow subflows provide reusable logic callable by flows with defined inputs and outputs. Verified against official vendor documentation: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-build-workflows/page/administer/flow-designer/concept/flow-designer.html

distractorReview.note: Each distractor is a real but non-reusable ServiceNow configuration concept and cannot encapsulate callable Flow Designer logic.
